mapper.select: SELECT id, parent_id, name, sort_order, created_by, created_at, updated_at FROM prompt_folders WHERE deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY parent_id NULLS FIRST, sort_order, id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO prompt_folders (parent_id, name, sort_order, created_by) VALUES (#{parentId}, #{name}, COALESCE(#{sortOrder}, 0), #{createdBy})
mapper.update: UPDATE prompt_folders SET name = #{name}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE prompt_folders SET deleted_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE prompt_folders SET sort_order = #{sortOrder}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id}
